items.title: SolarWinds Releases Advisory on Salesloft Drift Security Incident
items.description: SolarWinds has released an advisory regarding a security incident involving the Salesloft Drift integration for Salesforce, which led to unauthorized data access. The company confirmed that its own systems were not impacted by the breach, but is treating the matter with high priority.
